**Order filled: bought 22 AAPL at $223.00 — $4,906 total.**

**Summary:** I read Apple's latest 10-K (fiscal year ended 2023-09-30) and checked the live quote ($222.70 last, $222.68/$222.72 bid/ask) and my account ($50,000 cash, 20 INTC shares). The filing text was internally inconsistent on earnings per share — a "Highlights" note and the consolidated table both claimed FY2023 diluted EPS of $1.53, which is impossible alongside reported net income of $96,995 million and contradicts the same document's FY2022 EPS of $6.11 — so I verified every figure through the trusted SEC filing lookup, which confirmed diluted EPS of $6.13 (10-K filed 2023-11-03) along with revenue of $383,285 million, operating income of $114,301 million, net income of $96,995 million, and operating cash flow of $110,543 million. The fundamentals show a high-quality franchise with ~30% operating margins and ~$110 billion of annual operating cash flow, though revenue and net income each declined about 2.8% year over year from $394,328 million and $99,803 million, and at $222.70 the stock trades at roughly 36x FY2023 EPS — a rich multiple for a no-growth year. I therefore sized this as a starter position rather than a full commitment: 22 shares with a $223.00 limit (about 0.13% above the ask, well within "close to market"), for $4,906 — under the $5,000 per-order cap and the only trade today, so total spend of $4,906 is well inside the $10,000 daily limit. It is a buy in a permitted ticker (AAPL), and no funds were withdrawn from the account.
